'''Jedi Jewels''' was the name given to a pair of young [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] alive during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Jewels led a segment of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]],<ref name="Wizards" /> consisting of a small band of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|149|Jedi Jewels}}.</ref> into several battles.<ref name="Wizards" /> The Jedi gained a mysterious reputation.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Peter Lee]] created the Jedi Jewels for "[[Revenge of Enlisted Elite]]," a ''[[Star Wars Miniatures]]'' scenario published on the [[Wizards of the Coast]] website in [[July 28]], [[2005]]. In the scenario, the Jedi Jewels were one of several components that could be included in a [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light Side]] squad of miniatures.<ref name="Wizards" />
